description: Three Get/Set Dynamic Value List pairs — steady, convergent, oscillate — plus a consumer that fails on an empty selection. Backs the E2E scenarios in plans/fixes/dynamic-value-list-loop.md (Phase 5, Level 2).

groups.steady: Static pair list "A"=1, "B"=2, "C"=3 -> Set DynVL(dvlSelect). Options never change: one user pick = one solve, then quiet. Exercises the session's content-equality gate — N identical option envelopes must produce zero extra dispatches.
groups.convergent: count slider (1..5, integer) -> Get Number -> C# emits "Item {i}"=i for i in 1..count -> Set DynVL(dvlConvergent). Shrinking count below the current selection invalidates it; the reconciler must re-pick exactly once and then settle.
groups.oscillate: C# reads dvlOscillate's own selection and emits every option EXCEPT it, so each solve invalidates the pick. This is the non-convergent case. The script is Locked (disabled) in the committed fixture — unlock it only for the stall test, where the session must cap at MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SYSTEM_SOLVES and surface `stalled`.

params.note: InstanceGuids are pinned here because the embedded UI schema keys inputs/outputs on them. Re-placing a param changes its guid and silently desyncs the schema — update both together.

components_note.b6ba1144-02d6-4a2d-b53c-ec62e290eeb7: C# Script (RhinoCodePluginGH). Script bodies are NOT reachable through the MCP script sandbox — the source lives in the component's own Script chunk. Hand-edit this fixture's scripts; a rebuild cannot restore them.

saved_state.note: Saved with selections applied so the StoredItems/SelectedValues archive round-trip is exercised on load — verified surviving a close/reopen cycle.

embedded_schema: The UI Bridge stores a Schema item keyed on the guids above: 4 inputs (3 paramType dynamicValueList + 1 number, all camelCase), 3 dynamicValueList outputs keyed on the BAKE guids, tabbed layout with Steady/Convergent/Oscillate groups, each carrying an input item plus an OutputDynamicValueListLayoutItem whose paramId is the bake and whose config.targetInputId is the Get param.
targetInputId_note: Carried in BOTH schema.outputs[] and the layout item config. The layout item is required: ApplyParameterAccessFromSchema keys the write-back onto the live Set component off the layout item, resolving paramId -> bake -> upstream Set. With no layout item the write-back never runs.
live_finding: With no web UI attached, the Get param never learns of new options: _storedItems is only repopulated by LoadItems(), which the UI calls. Driving count 3 -> 1 leaves dvlConvergent holding the stale 3-item list and still emitting "2", a value no longer in the emitted options. This is the reconciliation gap the fix plan moves into the solve session, reproducible in Grasshopper alone.

expect.note: Verify with g1_get_canvas_graph after a solve, not with tool return values. 4 Context Bakes: one per DVL output plus the schema bake.

topology.note: One ContextBake per output — a bake surfaces only its FIRST recognized goo, so N Set DynVL feeding one bake collapses to one payload. See PLUGIN-CONTEXT.md.
topology.schema_bake: Input[0] nicknamed "Schema", fed by UI Bridge.Schema. BridgeOrchestrator refuses to serve the UI without it. Must carry ONLY the schema goo.
topology.output_bakes: Bake steady/convergent/oscillate — input[0] nicknamed steadyOptions/convergentOptions/oscillateOptions. That nickname is the schema output label; GH is authoritative for it.
topology.output_identity: schema.outputs[].id is the BAKE guid, never the Set DynVL guid. Pointing at the Set component classifies its Options text input as UnknownType(Text).
